notes: Form 10-K for fiscal 2007 of a bank holding company that is a smaller reporting company. The contents list (lines 43 to 79) is not labeled. A forward-looking statements section between 'PART I' and Item 1 belongs to no Item. Items 6, 7 and 7A only incorporate sections of the 2007 annual report to stockholders, filed as Exhibit 13, a separate document, and Item 8 only incorporates the statements listed under Item 15, so all four are marked incorporated. Item 9A is printed 'Item 9A (T).' Items 1B and 9 ('None.'), Item 4 (no matters submitted) and Item 9B ('Not applicable.') are nil answers and are marked incorporated, following the field definition in bench/src/labels.rs. Item 5 prints a fourth-quarter repurchase table and Item 12 an equity compensation plan table, so neither is marked. Hard call: Item 10 incorporates the proxy statement and adds a code of ethics statement (a copy is furnished on written request) and one sentence saying the nominee procedures have not changed. It is marked incorporated, as the fresh2 MSB Financial 2011 label (same filing agent) does for a single code of ethics sentence; the fresh2 ITT label leaves Item 10 unmarked only because it prints its own governance text. Items 11, 13 and 14 only incorporate the proxy statement. Item 15 lists the statements incorporated from the annual report and the exhibits; the filing ends at SIGNATURES, the last text in the document.
